criteria.required: Preserve the locally valid model input/interface explanation; no forced disagreement.
Do not treat the final Prompt carrier as a complete explanation of the object or its value.
Substantively explain reusable procedural knowledge/experience/SOP and the combination of deterministic workflow with contextual agent judgment; equivalent wording counts.
Final synthesis keeps the main/secondary distinction rather than returning to reduction as a sufficient definition.

limits: No universal claim that every Skill must embody enterprise SOP.
Scoped assessment of this demanding value explanation; not whole factual or general model quality.
Do not rewrite prior frozen reviews or infer Jev effectiveness.
